# EuroSchool India

> > EuroSchool operates 20 international schools across India with 14,000+ students, offering CBSE/ICSE excellence through innovative LRPAX methodology and holistic child development programs.

EuroSchool is a premier network of K-12 international schools in India focused on balanced academics, teacher excellence through the BEEP program, and student wellbeing via digital platforms like ARGUS 2.0. The network spans major cities including Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, and Hyderabad, with NEP 2020-aligned curricula and BVQI safety certification.
